question: How do all other dharmas relate to the encompassing Kula dharma?
premises: Kula dharma is presented as a comprehensive path.
All other dharmas are compared to things immersed in it.
Immersion implies inclusion within a greater whole.
inference: Therefore all dharmas are immersed in Kula dharma.
plain_english: O beloved, all dharmas are thus immersed in the Kula dharma.
